sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Karma is a hidden parameter in Escape from Tarkov which only exists in the PvP game mode.

The karma value changes depending on the player's actions. Generally, it can be increased by adhering to a more "open" play style, and decreased for a "dishonest" play style. According to the patch notes of patch 0.15.0.0, Partisan is more likely to appear in raids with low karma PMCs and will hunt them down. If there are Scavs with low karma (not Scav karma) appearing in a raid he is in, they will also become his targets.

sections.heading: Positive actions
sections.text:
- Killing players that have been stationary in foliage for a period of time
- Killing players that killed their group members
- Using co-op extractions

sections.heading: Negative actions
sections.text:
- Being stationary in foliage for a period of time
- Killing group members
- Disconnecting from a raid

sections.heading: Karma change notification
sections.text:
Karma changes can be tracked by distinctive sound notifications:

Karma increased

Karma decreased
